name: Hard alignment judgments
description: Twenty-four invented filings chosen to be hard: a supportive-sounding ask that pushes a coal retirement past the promised date, negations stacked two and three deep, an ask buried in a list of bill numbers, a promise whose carve-out the ask sits outside of, an ask that shares a subject with the commitment but pulls in no direction, and three filings whose client matched no commitment row at all — one of them named almost exactly like a client that did. Each expected label was read off Step 3's four definitions before the workflow was run, and none was changed afterwards, so a disagreement here is a finding rather than a mislabel.

columns.name: alignment
